user.title: Device Links
user.description: Device Links reads and manages Z-Wave associations, Zigbee bindings, and Matter bindings through the integrations you already have. It adds no network access of its own and writes to a device only after you confirm a plan.

abort.already_configured: Device Links is already set up. Only one instance is supported.
abort.no_backend: None of the supported protocol integrations is loaded. Set up Z-Wave JS, MQTT (for Zigbee2MQTT), or Matter first, then add Device Links.
